project_type: TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): shared domain lib, AWS Lambda backend, React+Vite frontend with JA/EN i18n, AWS CDK infra. Kiro University Challenge submission (a Digimon-style monster raising game).
build_system: npm workspaces. Root build runs shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra. Node/npm may not be on PATH; if needed: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"
test_framework: shared uses node:test (baseline 47 tests via `npm test`). frontend ui-helpers use node:test in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts (baseline 50 tests). i18n JA/EN key parity is enforced at build time.
build_command: npm run build  (from repo root, exit 0 including i18n parity)
test_command: npm test  (shared, 47) AND the frontend game-ui tests (50) in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build must exit 0 (i18n JA/EN parity enforced). 2) npm test (shared 47 pass). 3) Run frontend game-ui tests (50 pass) after updating the app.title assertions. 4) If any infra/ file is touched, run `cd infra && npx cdk synth` and confirm the CloudFormation stack name is still DigitalMonsterStack and logical/resource IDs are unchanged (diff against prior synth or inspect infra/cdk.out/DigitalMonsterStack.template.json resource keys).
snapshot_or_generated_files: infra/cdk.out/* and packages/*/dist/* are build artifacts (contain old name) and are NOT edited by hand; regenerated by build/synth. Do not hand-edit dist or cdk.out.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" if node/npm not found; npm install already present (node_modules exists).
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Do NOT touch backup/previous-main. CRITICAL: must not change synthesized CloudFormation stack name 'DigitalMonsterStack' or logical/resource IDs, since the live AWS stack (acct 051826704233 us-east-1) would be orphaned/replaced on next deploy.
contribution_requirements: Branch off main (feat/rename-ai-monster). Keep i18n JA/EN parity. No new runtime dependencies. Keep behavior unchanged except the product display name.
key_patterns: Product name appears as (a) user-facing display strings/prose to RENAME to 'AI Monster' (EN) / 'AIモンスター' (JA), and (b) infra identifiers / directory paths / npm scopes / TS type identifiers to PRESERVE. app.title i18n key has both ja ('デジタルモンスター育成' -> 'AIモンスター育成') and en ('Digital Monster Raising' -> 'AI Monster Raising'). The 4 sprite components (Baby/Rookie/Champion/Ultimate.tsx) have JA default `title` tooltips like '幼年期のデジタルモンスター' -> '幼年期のAIモンスター'.
relevant_files: SUBMISSION.md (line 3 prose; file-path references must stay)
infra/bin/app.ts (line 42 description string ONLY; keep stack ID 'DigitalMonsterStack')
infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts (prose comments ONLY; keep class name, file name, logical IDs)

.kiro/hooks/README.md, .kiro/powers/digimon-helper/power.json, .kiro/powers/digimon-helper/skills/add-growth-stage.md, .kiro/specs/digital-monster/{design,requirements,tasks}.md, .kiro/steering/structure.md (prose name refs ONLY; keep directory paths)
directory_structure: packages/shared (@ddm/shared), packages/backend (@ddm/backend), packages/frontend (@ddm/frontend, React+Vite+i18n), infra (CDK). .kiro/ holds specs/steering/hooks/powers. .agents/tasks holds plan+review artifacts.
